title: Selected Work
subtitle: Marketplace UX, multi-stakeholder coordination, AI in product and practice, design systems as engineering infrastructure — selected for Delivery Hero Quick Commerce

application.role: Senior Manager, User Experience (Quick Commerce — Dmart + Local Shops)
application.positioning: AI in product AND in practice · Design-system-as-API · Marketplace UX · Multi-stakeholder coordination · Efficiency-with-empathy
application.differentiator_wedge: Dual AI story (product + productivity) is the SOLE preferred qualification and disproportionately weighted for shortlist selection. Sibling DH filter (`deliveryhero.json`) was tuned for Service Efficiency with CS Copilot featured; this filter reweights featured set toward marketplace UX (grocery-vertical bridge) + measurable multi-stakeholder impact + AI-in-product headline. CS Copilot demotes to browseable — still visible AI-in-product evidence, no longer the story.

selection_rationale.spreadshirt-user-research-strategy: Featured #1 — closest thing Tobias has to a marketplace-UX credential and the primary bridge to the JD's implicit grocery-vertical gap. Print-on-demand two-sided marketplace with ~5,000 business sellers + hundreds of thousands of consumers; conversion-sensitive design-tool work; controlled-automation strategy change preserving creator agency (efficiency-with-empathy demonstration matching DH's cultural frame). Research-driven executive-influence pattern (user interviews + Axure mobile prototype + workshop facilitation → strategy shift) is the growth-tribe operating mode when metrics don't yet exist. Vintage (2014-2016) but pattern-consistent. Per verification log Δ3 + Δ5 + Δ6, this is THE bridge for the grocery-adjacency and consumer-conversion positioning.
selection_rationale.churchdesk-booking-system: Featured #2 — measurable impact (70% coordination-time reduction, 90% booking acceptance rate) + multi-stakeholder coordination (funeral homes ↔ pastors ↔ cemeteries ↔ families) as the adjacency bridge to q-commerce three-sided coordination (customer + rider + operator / merchant). Dual PM + design mandate. Only featured case study with 4 real screenshots already staged on disk — shippable-as-is. Per verification log Δ3 second-slot recommendation.
selection_rationale.ninox-ai-onboarding: Featured #3 — AI-in-product-development headline anchor for the sole preferred qualification. Vibe-coding onboarding (prompt-to-database with direct-manipulation editing, split-screen interaction model, beta Feb 2026). User-agency design principle articulated at organisational level ('show output and allow users to edit') — the kind of AI-integration philosophy DH's growth motion is presumably building against. 5 real screenshots already staged on disk. Chosen over bibeltv-support-agent for featured because Quick Commerce is consumer app growth (not internal CS tooling), so a consumer-facing AI product story lands better than a CS Copilot skill story here. Chosen over bibeltv-design-system-api for featured because AI is the disproportionately-weighted sole preferred qualification while design systems are an explicit responsibility but not the shortlist wedge — bibeltv-design-system-api sits browseable to remain visible.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-design-system-api: Browseable #1 — DTCG-standard single-source-of-truth token API sync'ing Figma / iOS / Android / web values. Direct evidence for the JD's explicit 'Champion design systems and pattern libraries' responsibility. DH runs 4+ consumer app entities on shared platforms — the multi-brand design-system engineering-integration pattern that ports directly is design-system-as-API sophistication. Placed browseable rather than featured because AI-in-product (ninox-ai-onboarding) wins the featured slot for shortlist weighting; bibeltv-design-system-api stays visible immediately behind 'show more' so a reader who cares about the design-system responsibility (interview / tech-vetting altitude) finds it without digging.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-agentic-engineering: Browseable #2 — AI-in-design-productivity anchor (second half of the dual AI story that is the JD's sole preferred qualification). Web → Android prototype via agentic coding with engineering consuming prototype code directly, collapsing design → prototype → shipped-code pipeline. Per verification log Δ4, both dimensions of the AI story (product + practice) need concrete case-study evidence for the disproportionately-weighted shortlist filter; this is the practice-side proof.
selection_rationale.ninox-org-building: Browseable #3 — direct language match to the JD's stated leadership style ('inspiring creativity and challenging established thinking'). Coached a design lead through a difficult engineering-lead partnership; reframed 'what's wrong with that person' as 'what's wrong with our system'; structured-collaboration habits spread beyond original accommodation to team norm. Per verification log Δ2 + Leadership & Strategic Assessment delta, this is the primary leadership-style evidence. Placed browseable because the featured set already carries three anchor stories; readers who dig for coaching evidence find this immediately.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-support-agent: Browseable #4 — DEMOTED from sibling application's featured slot #1. For Quick Commerce (consumer app growth), CS Copilot is background evidence of AI-in-product-development capability, not the featured story. Still visible so readers who scan the AI story across product-development dimensions find handbook-as-context + human-keeps-send-decision + escalation-as-first-class-output design principles. Per verification log Δ4 + Interview Prep §Top 5 STAR reranking (DEMOTED from #1 to #5).
selection_rationale.bibeltv-app-redesign: Hidden — consumer B2C content app design work, but off-vertical for Q-Commerce; more importantly, would over-weight Bibel TV in the surfaced set (already 2 Bibel TV entries in browseable). Held in reserve for interviewers who want additional consumer-app depth.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-ai-prototyping: Hidden — substantial overlap with bibeltv-agentic-engineering (which is browseable); flagged in-progress status with known AI-slop issues from earlier reviews. Not surface-ready. Same rationale as sibling filter.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-color-api: Hidden — niche craft depth at IC level; would pull the surfaced portfolio toward IC-craft rather than management-track. Role is Senior Manager under UX Director; craft credibility surfaces via design-system-as-API (which is management-altitude) rather than color-lab (which is craft-altitude).
selection_rationale.datameer-data-dense-analytics: Hidden — confidential flag set. Datameer regulated-industry banking customer base + usertesting.com iterative screening methodology surfaces in CV bullets + interview STAR bank, not on the portfolio surface. Same rationale as sibling filter.
